device.modelDescription: MCP conformance fixture: one action per result shape the MCP layer must handle

actionList.name: object_out
actionList.description: Returns {text: "ok"}; declares an object output schema.

actionList.name: no_schema_string
actionList.description: Returns a plain string and declares no output schema.

actionList.name: no_schema_object
actionList.description: Returns an object and declares no output schema.

actionList.name: no_schema_empty
actionList.description: Returns no output and declares no output schema.

actionList.name: prefix_items_out
actionList.description: Returns a pair; its output schema uses the 2020-12 prefixItems keyword.

actionList.name: coded_error
actionList.description: Fails with a typed error; declares a strict object output schema that an error code object would not satisfy.

actionList.name: strict_out
actionList.description: Returns a property its own output schema forbids, so the runtime rejects the call.

actionList.name: binary_out
actionList.description: Returns a PNG chart, two WAV clips and a PDF, each declared contentEncoding: base64.

actionList.name: many_images_out
actionList.description: Returns 17 PNG images: one more than a result may carry.

actionList.name: big_image_out
actionList.description: Returns a 2 MiB PNG: inline until M6 adds the 1 MiB threshold.

actionList.name: array_out
actionList.description: Returns ["a", "b"]; declares an array output schema.

actionList.name: string_out
actionList.description: Returns the string "plain"; declares a string output schema.

actionList.name: number_out
actionList.description: Returns 3; declares a number output schema.

actionList.name: null_out
actionList.description: Returns null; declares a null output schema.

actionList.name: binary_whole_out
actionList.description: Returns a PNG as its whole output, declared contentEncoding: base64.

actionList.name: images_array_out
actionList.description: Returns two PNGs as an array, its items declared contentEncoding: base64.
